remarks: Welcome to easy living in this meticulously maintained STUDIO (HEAT & HOT WATER INCLUDED!) in one of downtown Stamford's most prime locations. A sunny, open concept layout with a spacious kitchen, huge walk-in-closet and a pristine full bath makes this the perfect place to call home. Laundry in the building plus a private storage unit, too! With just steps to bars, restaurants, shopping, seasonal farmer's market and across the street from the Avon Theater, it doesn't get any better than this! Garage parking is available just a couple of blocks away at the Bedford-Forest-Broad Street Garage for approximately $50/month. Do not miss out!
